compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-render-closure-narrative.sh before the script exists (RED). Tests must fail until T2.

## Test Cases
1. Given typed verifier JSON with all fields → outputs expected narrative string
2. Same input run 3 times → identical output (determinism assertion)
3. Missing criteria_results field → exits non-zero with structured error
4. Narrative contains no LLM-generated prose markers (no 'I determined', 'appears to', 'seems')

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-render-closure-narrative.sh exits non-zero (RED)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-render-closure-narrative.sh

## Testing Mode
RED
